# Military OneSource

> Military OneSource provides comprehensive support services including confidential counseling, coaching, benefits navigation, and 24/7 assistance for military members and their families.

Military OneSource is the Department of Defense's official support program offering free, confidential counseling and consultations to active duty, reserve, and National Guard service members, retirees, and their families. The program supports mission readiness and quality of life through a wide range of services including mental health counseling, specialty coaching, and resource navigation.

## Key Topics

- Military families
- Confidential counseling
- 24/7 support services
- Benefits finder
- Coaching and consultations
- Military and Family Life Counseling Program
- Spouse support

- Mission readiness
- Military OneSource Connect
- Adoption support
- Elder care assistance
- Education planning
- Resource directory
- Service member support

## Core Services

- [Confidential Counseling](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/confidential-counseling): Free, confidential counseling services for military members and families.
- [Coaching & Consultations](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/coaching-consultations): Specialty coaching and consultations for adoption, education, elder care, and wellness.
- [Benefits Finder](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/benefits/benefits-finder): Searchable benefits finder for military service members and their families.
- [Resources Finder](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/resources/resources-finder): Searchable resource directory supporting mission readiness and quality of life.

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/contact-us): 24/7 contact options: phone (800-342-9647) and secure live chat support.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/general-frequently-asked-questions-faqs): Frequently asked questions about Military OneSource services and eligibility.

## About & Information

- [About Military OneSource](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/about-us): Overview of Military OneSource counseling and support services for military families.
- [News & Events](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/news): News releases, events and media resources from Military OneSource.
